description: Unity LevelPlay mediation plugin (v1 GodotPlugin) - multi-network waterfall/bidding: Unity Ads, Meta, AdMob, AppLovin, Mintegral, Liftoff, DT Exchange, ... Active networks are configured on the LevelPlay dashboard; more networks = append their adapter to gradle_deps. Java source staged into <project>/android/build/src/main/java; gradle deps + manifest meta-data + Ads autoload rewritten by materialize.
requires_networks_config: app_key + 3 ad unit ids from https://app.unity.com (Grow -> LevelPlay). Until provided, init fails gracefully and the game runs ad-free.
